sanity.shadow-monster.creeper-fear.name: Creeper Fear
sanity.shadow-monster.terrorbeak.name: Terrorbeak
darkness-attack.prompt.warning: Something in the darkness is rapidly approaching you!
darkness-attack.prompt.resolved: You have been attacked by the darkness!
darkness-attack.prompt.escaped: You have returned to the light!
minigame-danger-blocked: There is danger nearby! You cannot play this game!
minigame-danger-blocked-starving: You are too hungry to play this game! Eat something first!
fishing-starving-blocked: You are too hungry to fish! Eat something first!
sleep-confirmation.title: Sleep confirmation
sleep-confirmation.body: Your current Hunger is too low. Going to sleep now will be very dangerous. Continue?
hunger-death.hospital.1: Someone found you collapsed on the floor from low blood sugar... so I gave you an emergency glucose infusion!
darkness-death.hospital.1: Someone found you collapsed on the floor covered in wounds... so I performed emergency surgery on you!
darkness-death.hospital.2: It hasn't been very safe at night lately. Make sure to bring a light source when you go out, and don't stay out too late, okay?
hunger-death.mine.linus.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. You were lucky I happened to be passing by and gave you a few Sweet Berries!
hunger-death.mine.linus.2: If you're having trouble in life, come talk to me, okay?
hunger-death.mine.robin.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I thought you were a shriveled-up walking stick!
hunger-death.mine.robin.2: Remember to bring food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.clint.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I dragged you all the way here, and you are shockingly light!
hunger-death.mine.clint.2: Even if you're dieting, you need to eat enough before going into the mines. Remember to bring food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.maru.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I was looking for minerals and almost didn't see you!
hunger-death.mine.maru.2: Remember to bring more food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.maru-spouse.1: ...I found you unconscious in the mines from hunger. You had been gone so long that I started to worry!
hunger-death.mine.maru-spouse.2: Please, please bring more food next time, okay?
hunger-death.island.willy.2: I was so worried... I thought you were so hungry you had to drink seawater to survive! Bring plenty of food when you're out there...
hunger-death.island.willy.3: This island doesn't have food everywhere.
hunger-death.island.leo.2: My bird friends found you and told me you were passed out from hunger, so I dragged you here.
hunger-death.island.leo.3: Please take better care of yourself out there. I don't want to be sad again...
config.enable-hunger-system.name: Hunger
config.hunger-damage-mode.name: Hunger damage
config.hunger-damage-mode.tooltip: Controls whether Hunger damage can be lethal. In non-lethal mode, Hunger damage won't reduce Health below 20%.
config.sleep-recovery-balance.name: Sleep recovery balance
config.sleep-recovery-balance.tooltip: When enabled, players spend Hunger to restore Sanity and Health.
config.enable-sanity-system.name: Sanity
config.sanity-monster-intensity.name: Sanity monsters
config.sanity-monster-intensity.tooltip: Affects the number and spawn rate of Sanity monsters.
config.dark-hand-mode.name: Dark Hand
config.dark-hand-mode.tooltip: Affects how Dark Hands interact with the world.
config.sanity-natural-drain-rule.name: Natural Sanity Drain Rule
config.sanity-natural-drain-rule.tooltip: How passive sanity drains naturally. Time and place: the existing seasonal nightfall/midnight and mine-area rules. By light level: Don't Starve rules - no drain in daytime, dusk/night/mines tiered by the light actually at your feet with a 10x fast tier in near-darkness, and no drain when light evidence is unavailable. Off: both natural drains stop. Nearby monsters, equipment, NPCs, bathhouse and other sources are unaffected.
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.name: Low-Sanity filter
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.tool: Affects the shader effects at low Sanity.
config.enable-low-sanity-screen-distorti: Affects screen drift, shake, and distortion when Sanity is low.
config.enable-dont-starve-health.name: Don't Starve-style Health
config.enable-dont-starve-health.tooltip: Makes the player's Health rules more like Don't Starve.
config.enable-natural-darkness.name: Darkness
config.darkness-damage-mode.name: Darkness damage
config.darkness-damage-mode.tooltip: Controls whether darkness damage can be lethal. In non-lethal mode, darkness damage can't reduce the player's Health below 20%.
config.enable-dont-starve-light-ambience: Renders day/dusk/mines/interiors at Don't Starve light levels: DST warm daylight, and a 3-second dusk fade to the DST dusk light value. Night darkening plus mine/interior full-dark remain controlled by the Darkness toggle; with Darkness off the night holds the dusk value. Mines are lit as if fully covered by cave skylights (warm-green day, blue dusk, night owned by Darkness); Volcano Dungeon uses cave levels; the clinic never darkens. Full moon awaits a moon-phase system.
config.enable-seed-edibility.name: Enable seed edibility
config.enable-seed-edibility.tooltip: Allows players to force-feed seeds by right-clicking them in the inventory.
config.enable-danger-minigame-blocking.t: When enabled, players can't enter minigames while in danger, and attacks interrupt fishing.
config.monster-difficulty-profile.name: Monster strength
config.enable-health-effect-balance.name: Health effect balance
config.enable-health-effect-balance.tool: When enabled, food Health recovery follows Don't Starve-style rules. Foods with negative Edibility reduce Health based on Stamina change x 0.45.
config.enable-junimo-blessing.name: Junimo protection
config.enable-junimo-blessing.tooltip: Protects farms, farmhouses, cellars, farm caves, greenhouses, Ginger Island farmhouses, the abandoned JojaMart, the Community Center, and player-built interiors from natural darkness, and protects players from darkness attacks.
config.enable-combat-auto-swing.name: Hold-to-Swing (Master)
config.enable-combat-auto-swing.tooltip: While holding the left mouse button, keep swinging the current weapon. Release to stop.
config.auto-swing-sword.name: Swords
config.auto-swing-sword.tooltip: Hold-to-Swing applies to swords (including the three scythes).
config.auto-swing-club.name: Clubs
config.auto-swing-dagger.name: Daggers
config.slingshot-auto-release.name: Slingshot
config.slingshot-auto-release.tooltip: While holding, auto-fire once the charge reaches the set slingshot power.
config.slingshot-power.name: Slingshot Power
config.slingshot-power.tooltip: The charge level required for auto-fire. Minimum is 25%, maximum is 100%.
config.auto-special-mode.name: Auto Special Move
config.auto-special-mode.tooltip: Automatically trigger weapon special moves: swords auto-parry when a monster gets close (any time); clubs and daggers auto-trigger their smash/stab while attacking.
config.enable-mouse-facing.name: Face Mouse Cursor
config.enable-mouse-facing.tooltip: While attacking or using a tool: the player turns toward the mouse at each swing or tool use.
config.enable-sanity-vignette.name: Vignette
config.enable-sanity-vignette.tooltip: Affects the vignette filter in the four corners of the screen.
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.name: Dawn/dusk sound effects
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.tooltip: Enables Don't Starve-style dawn/dusk sound effects.
config.enable-status-feedback-sounds.too: Play Don't Starve-style HUD sounds for one-time changes in Health, Hunger, and Sanity.
config.enable-activity-music.name: Four Seasons Music
config.enable-activity-music.tooltip: Plays Don't Starve-style four-season music during work and combat.
config.enable-farming-music.name: Farming Music
config.enable-farming-music.tooltip: Enables the farming music from Don't Starve Together's Reap What You Sow update.
